name: Tilia
description: Tilia is a website template for psychotherapy practices that see adults, couples and teenagers in person and online, with a three question matcher that suggests a therapist and their next free appointment, a crisis box with helpline numbers for anyone who cannot wait, therapist cards with approach, languages and the next slot, a calm description of the first meeting, a price table and FAQ. Soft linen tones, deep navy and Spectral serif headings give the website a quiet, reassuring character. Replace the copy, photos, therapists, fees and helpline numbers with your own and check them against the professional ethics rules before publishing.
features: Three question matcher that suggests a therapist and the next free appointment
Crisis box with free helpline numbers
Common reasons people come, in their own words
Therapist cards with approach, languages and the next slot
First meeting described step by step
Price table with session lengths and the cancellation rule
Service pages for individual, couples and teenage therapy
Contact section with directions to the practice
